background.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a brand-new full-bleed landscape fishing game environment, wide 16:9, for the RiverKing winter event at Tasaki Kannon Cape (太崎観音崎), Tarumizu shore of the inner Kagoshima Bay, Japan. Use the attached screenshot only as geographic, sunset and composition mood reference. View at the water's edge looking toward the recognizable broad low multi-summit Sakurajima volcanic massif across the bay, with one small pale plume drifting naturally. Late December at dusk: warm orange-pink grazing light on the ridge, icy slate-blue marine water, cool lilac shadows, traces of thin rime or light dusting on the dark volcanic rocks at the lower corners and sparing cold light on evergreen Japanese pine branches. Keep the sea unfrozen and the coastal vegetation believable for southern Kyushu. Pine boughs frame primarily the top and upper side edges; branches and rocks are edge framing, never covering the main fishing area. Keep the full center and middle lower 55% of the frame open as clean softly rippled water, with a calm readable near-water surface; horizon about 40% from top and the volcano and small plume legible in a narrow central portrait crop. Polished naturalistic game key art with realistic shapes and textures, subtle atmospheric depth, no fantasy exaggeration. No text, icons, UI, screenshots, people, boats, buildings, torii, borders or watermark.

prompts.madai: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one RiverKing fish card asset, a natural-history digital illustration with fine hand-painted scale and fin detail, using the existing grouper image only as a style/framing reference. Depict this new species independently and accurately. Strict left-side lateral profile, head left, tail right, one adult specimen only, full silhouette, centered on a 1:1 square with generous left and right clear margins, no cropping. Clean neutral side lighting. Truly transparent alpha outside the fish including around fins, no checkerboard drawn in, no shadows, halos, labels, water or props. Madai, red seabream (Pagrus major). A moderately deep oval compressed body, slightly steep forehead, small terminal mouth, coppery pink-red flanks fading to satin silver-white belly, scattered tiny electric-blue pin spots mainly along the upper side. One long dorsal fin with a front section of clear spines, small pink pectorals, distinctly forked rose tail with a dark trailing edge. Small sparse dots, natural rosy color, never the orange spotted grouper body.

prompts.tachiuo: Use case: scientific-educational. Paint exactly one adult Japanese cutlassfish, タチウオ (Trichiurus japonicus), as a natural-history RiverKing game sprite on truly transparent alpha. Strict side elevation, head at left and tiny tapering whip tip at right, full animal in frame on a square with a 5% margin. Real-world fish anatomy: exceptionally elongated and laterally compressed, long smooth scaleless silvery ribbon with a subtle blue-gray back, small pointed toothed face, prominent round eye, small pectoral behind gill cover, continuous narrow close-to-body dorsal fin, anal fin reduced to tiny inconspicuous spines. Tail tapers to a very fine natural point, without a caudal fin. Keep the continuous dorsal fin closely articulated with fine rays. Restrained satin painted highlights entirely inside the contour. Give the fish a precise clean alpha silhouette with finely resolved fin edges, fully blank transparent space beyond its contour and no disconnected flecks, shiny halos, white rim, backdrop, ground or water. No text or objects.
